$description: The NCode mark, {N}: N for NCode inside the curly braces of code, drawn on a 64-unit grid from straight lines and circular arcs. build.mjs draws every file in logo/ncode/ and brace/brace-mark.svg from these numbers, in the colors of the blue ramp in tokens.source.json: blue.600 NCode Blue, blue.300 NCode Blue Light and blue.900 NCode Navy.
name: NCode
$names: name: the product the mark stands for, the title of every SVG and the web manifest's name. shortName: the web manifest's short_name. prefix: how every file's name starts. letters: what lib/logo.mjs draws between the braces, N or id. outlinesDescription: the $description of outlines.json.
$fields: size: the square canvas. stroke: the braces' stroke. stem: the N's two stems. diagonal: the N's diagonal, measured along the horizontal. brace: x of the left brace's beak tip and of its hook ends. beakRadius: center-line radius of the two arcs into the beak. hookRadius: center-line radius of the two hooks. braceY: top and bottom of the braces. nX, nY: left and right, top and bottom of the N. taper: how much thinner than the stroke the beak's tip is. beakY: the beak's center, when it isn't the middle of the brace. staircase: the diagonal as steps (columns, rows per step).
$master: Braces: a stroke of 4, 48 high. N: stems of 5, 24 wide and 32 tall. 4 units clear left and right, 8 above and below.
$fitted: The same drawing with every stem on whole pixels, for the sizes where half a pixel shows. At 16: one-pixel strokes, the beak moved up half a pixel onto a row, and the diagonal as a staircase.
$fit: How much of its square the mark covers: tight, across seven eighths of it, where the picture is shown small (favicons, NuGet, badges); regular on tiles and avatars; safe inside the center circle of 80% of the width, where a circle is cut from it (profile pictures, maskable icons).

tileRadius.note: the corner radius of a rounded tile, in the 64 units of its width

$lockups: Each lockup is the mark and the wordmark in one drawing, width by height units. mark: the mark's scale and where its canvas's corner goes. wordmark: where the wordmark's path goes. markDigits: the decimals of the mark's part of the lockup's SVG path; the wordmark's part has 2. heights: the heights of its PNG files. file names its files, and key its entry in outlines.json. The cards carry the first lockup.

lockups.note: the mark's 64, 8 clear, the wordmark, and 4 clear as on the left; the wordmark's path is already in place

$cards: The first lockup centered on a solid card, at most widest of the card's width, scaled in quarter steps. banner: the profile banners. preview: the link previews and GitHub's social preview. descriptor: the descriptor under the lockup.

wordmark.note: "NCode" set in Inter Display Medium and converted to outlines, so no file needs the font: its glyphs for N, C, o, d and e at the font's own advances (it kerns none of these pairs), scaled so the capitals are as tall as the mark's N, 32 units, which makes the stems about as heavy too. They stand on the N's line (y = 48) and start 72 units from the lockup's left edge.

outlinesDescription: The {N} mark and its lockup as SVG path data, filled with the nonzero rule. "mark" is the master on its 64-unit grid; "fitted" is the drawing for each small size, whose stems lie on whole pixels at that size; "brace" is the mark's left brace alone, which a right brace mirrors. Generated by build.mjs from src/logo/ncode.json.
